note: Linear tweens, in milliseconds. A swap is a SPEED — `swapMsPerCell` times the straight-line distance the pieces travel, floored at `swapMinMs` so a one-cell swap is still visible; any two cells can be swapped, so that distance runs from 1 to about 8. `holdMs` is a still beat after each phase; `staggerMs` delays each piece by how far it sits from whatever fired, so a shoved run reads as a wave rather than a block; `splitBeats` plays a step's movement and its destruction as two beats. `shake` is the wobble on a cell being destroyed. Tune in dev/timing.html.
